name: Farm stand
adds: Villagers buy fresh produce; stand behind the counter to serve them

name: Vegetable field
adds: Six plots of vegetables; stand on a ripe one to harvest it

name: Old well
adds: Water for the fields: crops grow 35% faster

name: Corn field
adds: Six plots of corn, which sells for more

name: Hen house
adds: Hens lay eggs; pack them into cartons at the egg table. Villagers love fresh eggs (+15% villagers)

name: Red barn
adds: Stores the harvest: the stand holds 10 more crates, and every sale pays 20% more

name: Farmhand
adds: Harvests the fields and stocks the stand

name: Egg collector
adds: Packs the eggs and takes the cartons to the stand

name: Stand helper
adds: Serves at the farm stand and minds the till: cash keeps piling up while you are away

name: Cow barn
adds: Three cows give milk; bottle it at the dairy. Milk sells for more than anything else

name: Farm gate sign
adds: +30% villagers stopping by

name: Feed store
adds: Corn tipped in feeds the animals: fed hens lay twice as fast, fed cows give 50% more milk

name: Farm pickup
adds: A pickup parked by the fields: the farmhand loads it right there (no walks to the barn, so half as much again is picked), and it takes full loads to the barn

name: Milker
adds: Bottles the milk and takes it to the stand or the vans

name: Farm van
adds: Delivery orders open: pick one on the board, load the van with eggs or crates, and it brings back far more than the stand

name: Delivery driver
adds: The vans take the best orders by themselves

name: Milk tanker
adds: Big milk orders for the village; the rival loses his grip on Willowbrook

name: Apple orchard
adds: Six apple trees: slow to ripen, but a crate of apples sells for $200

name: Feed truck
adds: Brings feed from town whenever the feed store runs low: the animals are always fed

name: Combine harvester
adds: Sweeps the corn field whenever it is ripe: two crates a plot, and straw for feed

name: Farm manager
adds: Runs the whole farm: full earnings while you are in another town

name: Mill and bakery
adds: Grinds corn from the barn and bakes it: bread, and apple pies when there are apples

name: Baker
adds: Takes the baking from the bread table to the stand, the market and the vans

name: Farmers' market
adds: Market stalls by the road: weekend crowds (+60% villagers) paying 50% more

name: Market staff
adds: Serves at the market stalls

name: Willowbrook Windmill
adds: The village's landmark, restored: +20% on every sale in Willowbrook

name: Road to Maple Market Town
adds: The way to Chapter 3; offered once every town goal is done
